description: Read the connection invitations waiting on your connected account, each with an invitation_id, the sender as a person, the optional message and sent_at. Costs $0.0012 per read. Answer one with invitation_accept or invitation_decline. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.
